candidates.source_attribution: Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan I-III (Three Books of Meqabyan, መጽሐፈ መቃብያን) — Tewahedo broader-canon Ethiopian Maccabees, distinct from the Greek LXX 1-4 Maccabees (different content; shared title only). English translation from the Modern Amharic of the EOTC Bible (nehemiah-osc.org) by Claude (Anthropic) with collaborator, May 2026. Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication (archive.org/details/three-books-of-meqabyan-cc0-translation). Apparatus integrates Josef Horovitz, 'Das äthiopische Maccabäerbuch,' Zeitschrift für Assyriologie XIX (1905), pp. 194-233 — PD primary scholarly study. 64-citation third-pass audit verdict matrix; 57 verified, 4 errors corrected, 3 interpretive readings flagged, 7 newly discovered parallels added. Dating widened to Aksumite-to-Solomonic Ethiopian Christian range (4th-14th c. CE); precise composition date undetermined in current scholarship per Horovitz 1905 non-commitment. Three books: 1 Mq 36 chapters (Maqabis-of-Benjamin martyrology vs Ṣiruṣaydan); 2 Mq 21 chapters (Maqabis-of-Moab conversion + sons' martyrdom + Ṣiruṣaydan's death); 3 Mq 10 chapters (homiletic + angelological dialogue + Satan-refused-Adam tradition + resurrection-doctrine).

OPENS Ch 32 — HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR: continued near-final arc. The chapter likely develops the SECOND-WILDERNESS-WANDERING typology (continuing Ch 31's wilderness-provision theme into a deeper articulation). The second-wilderness-wandering theme parallels: NUMBERS 33 (the comprehensive wilderness-stations-catalog); DEUTERONOMY 1-3 (Moses's wilderness-rehearsal-and-interpretation); HEBREWS 3:7-4:11 (the wilderness-generation-and-rest application); 1 CORINTHIANS 10:1-13 (the wilderness-warning typology — 'they were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted'); PSALM 95:7-11 (the wilderness-generation-as-warning); JUDE 5 (Christ-destroyed-the-unbelieving-wilderness-generation). Tewahedo monastic-tradition preserves the wilderness-wandering-as-spiritual-formation typology — the Däbrä-monasteries (Däbrä Libanos + Däbrä Damo + Däbrä Hayq Istifanos) as institutional-wilderness-retreat-pattern. The Meqabyan chapter likely articulates the wilderness-as-spiritual-formation-pedagogy adjacent to the narrative martyr-arc.

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of TESTING-AS-PURIFICATION theme. The testing-as-purification theme parallels: PROVERBS 17:3 ('the fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts'); JOB 23:10 ('when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold'); PSALM 12:6 ('the words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times'); PSALM 66:10-12 ('thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried'); MALACHI 3:2-3 (the refiner's-fire + the fullers'-soap); WISDOM 3:1-9 ('they shall be tried as gold in the furnace, and received as a burnt offering'); 1 PETER 1:6-7 ('trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire'); JAMES 1:2-4 (the trying-of-your-faith). Patristic-tradition: TERTULLIAN De Patientia (the patience-as-purification); CYPRIAN De Mortalitate (suffering-as-purification); GREGORY OF NYSSA De Anima et Resurrectione (the purification-and-deification). Tewahedo monastic-pedagogy preserves testing-as-purification as the integral-mechanism of spiritual-formation.

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of FAITHFULNESS-IN-THE-LITTLE theme (preparing Ch 33's manna-as-daily-bread typology). The faithfulness-in-the-little theme parallels: LUKE 16:10-13 ('he that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much'); LUKE 19:17 (the talents-parable Lukan version — 'thou hast been faithful in a very little'); MATTHEW 25:21 par. ('thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things'); 1 CORINTHIANS 4:2 (it-is-required-in-stewards-that-a-man-be-found-faithful); EXODUS 16:16-21 (the manna-collected-according-to-daily-need — the foundational little-faithfulness narrative); MATTHEW 6:11 par. (the Lord's-Prayer's give-us-this-day-our-daily-bread). Patristic-tradition: BASIL Long Rules + Short Rules (the monastic faithfulness-in-the-little pedagogy); JOHN CLIMACUS Ladder Step 21 (un-mannishness as faithfulness-in-the-little). Tewahedo monastic-pedagogy preserves faithfulness-in-the-little as the diagnostic-test-of-mature-spiritual-formation.
